guideTitle: From kana to Japanese typing practice
guideIntro: Pokotype is an online Japanese typing practice tool. Learn romaji input with hiragana and katakana, then build fluency with short passages that include kana readings and Chinese translations.
stepRange: Choose hiragana or katakana and a practice range above. Start with basic kana, then add voiced sounds, semi-voiced sounds and contracted sounds.
stepKeyboard: Use a computer keyboard with English input enabled and type the romaji for each kana. Keep hints on while learning the keys, then try practicing without them.
stepReview: Review your speed and accuracy after each session and revisit unfamiliar kana. Practice records stay in your current browser.
romajiTitle: More than one spelling can be correct
romajiIntro: Pokotype accepts each of these romaji spellings. The remaining hint adapts to the valid spelling you choose.
romajiNote: Type kana as written in article practice: the particles は, へ and を use ha, he and wo. Punctuation and spaces are skipped automatically. Open Input rules during practice for the full guide.
freeQuestion: Do I need an account or payment?
freeAnswer: Kana practice and built-in sample articles are free, with no account or API key required. Optional AI article generation uses your own API key and is billed under your model provider’s terms.
nextAnswer: Start with a short passage about daily life. Read the Japanese text, kana reading and Chinese translation, then practice by sentence, in groups or as a full article. You can read on your phone; typing practice requires a computer keyboard.
firstSample: Read the beginner passage 小さな朝の習慣
samplesIntro: Three original samples include the full Japanese text, kana readings and Chinese translations, with no API key required. N5–N3 labels are approximate practice levels, not official JLPT questions or certifications.
readingTitle: Japanese text, kana and Chinese translation
practiceHelp: After reading, choose sentence, group or full-article practice. Use a computer keyboard with English input enabled to type.

samples.sample-morning: Practice everyday expressions and basic kana input in four sentences about waking up, breakfast and getting ready for school.
samples.sample-station: Take a train to the seaside with a friend and practice expressions about stations, tickets and the scenery along the way.
samples.sample-library: Spend a rainy afternoon reading in a library and practice connecting kana readings in longer sentences.
